players.product: Firefly / Acrobat AI Assistant / GenStudio AI creative and marketing applications

quarterly_data.signal: Record Q2 revenue driven by subscription bookings to revenue conversion; raised full-year revenue and non-GAAP EPS targets
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue $6.62 billion, up 11% year-over-year in constant currency (13% as reported); non-GAAP EPS $5.96, up 18%; total ending ARR $27.1 billion, growing 12.5% year-over-year

quarterly_data.signal: AI product monetization scaling: AI-first ARR up 3x year-over-year; Firefly ARR grew approximately 50% quarter-over-quarter through Firefly apps and credit packs; Acrobat AI Assistant ARR growing approximately 3x year-over-year; strong generative credit consumption driven by video and audio
quarterly_data.figure: AI-first ARR greater than $500 million; Firefly ending ARR approaching $300 million; Acrobat and Express MAU surpassed 850 million (from greater than 700 million a year ago); creative freemium MAU crossed 90 million, growing over 70% year-over-year

quarterly_data.signal: Raised FY2026 targets, now including the Semrush acquisition ($480 million ARR added); strategic shift to aggressive freemium user acquisition lowers second-half ARR growth expectations from individual subscribers
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 total revenue target $26.5 billion-$26.6 billion; total ending ARR growth of 10.2% year-over-year; non-GAAP EPS $24.35-$24.45; Q3 revenue target $6.67 billion-$6.72 billion
